message.content: The most iconic and widely recognized sculpture of the 19th century is **the Statue of Liberty** (Liberty Enlightening the World). Completed in 1886 and gifted by France to the United States, it has become a global symbol of freedom and democracy. Its monumental size, dramatic design, and the historical context in which it was erected have cemented its place as the most famous sculpture of that era.
